<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Elon Musk: From Pretoria to Mars</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@300;500;700;900&family=Archivo:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ THEME ============ */
:root{
  --bg:#F3F1F8; --bg2:#E6E1F0; --ink:#1B1530; --muted:#655C7E; --line:#CFC8DE;
  --mars:#E2511F; --ice:#0E8FB5; --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.62); --star:27,21,48;
  --ps:#C2410C; --pc:#1D6FB8; --pp:#7A3FB0; --ps-bg:#FBE3D6; --pc-bg:#DCEBF8; --pp-bg:#ECDFF7;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    color-scheme:dark;
    --bg:#120E1A; --bg2:#1E1530; --ink:#F2EEF7; --muted:#A99FBF; --line:#3A2F52;
    --mars:#FF6B3D; --ice:#9FE8FF; --glass:rgba(30,21,48,.55); --star:242,238,247;
    --ps:#FF9A6E; --pc:#8CC8FF; --pp:#CFA6FF; --ps-bg:#3B2018; --pc-bg:#152E4A; --pp-bg:#2E2045;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#120E1A; --bg2:#1E1530; --ink:#F2EEF7; --muted:#A99FBF; --line:#3A2F52;
  --mars:#FF6B3D; --ice:#9FE8FF; --glass:rgba(30,21,48,.55); --star:242,238,247;
  --ps:#FF9A6E; --pc:#8CC8FF; --pp:#CFA6FF; --ps-bg:#3B2018; --pc-bg:#152E4A; --pp-bg:#2E2045;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html,body{height:100%}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 80% 10%,var(--bg2),var(--bg) 60%);background-color:var(--bg);
  color:var(--ink);font-family:"Archivo",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;overflow:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mars);outline-offset:3px}
.disp{font-family:"Unbounded","Archivo Black",system-ui,sans-serif}

#stars{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0}
#odo{position:fixed;right:-1vw;bottom:8vh;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(7rem,26vw,22rem);line-height:.8;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--line);opacity:.9;letter-spacing:-.04em;transition:opacity .4s}
#odo.hide{opacity:0}

/* ============ STAGE ============ */
#stage{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:1.5rem clamp(1.25rem,5vw,4rem) 6.5rem}
.scene{width:100%;max-width:1150px;transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.scene.out{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-24px) scale(.98)}
.scene.in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px) scale(.98)}

.year{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,4rem);align-items:center}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--mars);margin-bottom:1rem}
.tag i{width:.6rem;height:.6rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mars);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--mars)}
.tag.b{color:var(--ice)} .tag.b i{background:var(--ice);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--ice)}
.yr{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.2rem,2.5vw,1.6rem);color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.year h2{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.8rem);line-height:1.02;margin:.3rem 0 1.2rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.year p.body{font-size:clamp(1.1rem,1.9vw,1.45rem);line-height:1.5;margin:0;max-width:34ch}

.frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--glass);
  border:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:grid;place-items:center}
.frame::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 3px,rgba(var(--star),.035) 3px 4px)}
.frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.frame svg.icon{width:58%;height:auto;color:var(--ice);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ice) 60%,transparent))}
.frame .cap{position:absolute;left:1rem;bottom:1rem;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);background:var(--glass);padding:.3rem .7rem;border-radius:999px}
.frame .ed{position:absolute;top:1rem;right:1rem;display:none;gap:.4rem;z-index:3}
body.editing .frame .ed{display:flex}
.ed button{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:.45rem .9rem;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700}

/* grammar highlighting */
.v{border-radius:5px;padding:0 .12em;margin:0 -.12em;transition:background .25s,color .25s}
body.grammar .v.ps{background:var(--ps-bg);color:var(--ps);font-weight:700}
body.grammar .v.pc{background:var(--pc-bg);color:var(--pc);font-weight:700}
body.grammar .v.pp{background:var(--pp-bg);color:var(--pp);font-weight:700}
.legend{display:none;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.4rem;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700}
body.grammar .legend{display:flex}
.legend span{padding:.2rem .6rem;border-radius:6px}
.legend .ps{background:var(--ps-bg);color:var(--ps)} .legend .pc{background:var(--pc-bg);color:var(--pc)} .legend .pp{background:var(--pp-bg);color:var(--pp)}

/* title */
.title h1{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,12vw,10rem);line-height:.86;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.title h1 span{display:block;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--ink)}
.title .hook{font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2.2vw,1.6rem);max-width:30ch;margin:1.8rem 0 0;line-height:1.4}
.title .who{margin-top:2rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.title .who b{color:var(--ink)}
.start{margin-top:2rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;background:var(--mars);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:1rem 1.6rem;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem}

/* part divider */
.part{text-align:left}
.part .num{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:300;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.3rem;margin:0}
.part h2{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,8rem);line-height:.9;margin:.5rem 0 1rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.part.a h2{color:var(--mars)} .part.b h2{color:var(--ice)}
.part p{font-size:clamp(1.1rem,2vw,1.5rem);max-width:34ch;margin:0}
.part .speaker{margin-top:1.6rem;font-weight:700}

/* voice */
.voice h2{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,3rem);margin:.2rem 0 1.6rem}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.2rem}
.card{position:relative;text-align:left;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;
  padding:1.5rem;min-height:15rem;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.card .when{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin:0 0 .8rem}
.card .direct{font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.5rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.35;margin:0}
.card .rep{display:none;margin:1rem 0 0;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.8vw,1.3rem);line-height:1.45}
.card .shift{display:none;margin:.6rem 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.card[aria-expanded="true"] .rep,.card[aria-expanded="true"] .shift{display:block}
.card .hint{display:inline-block;margin-top:1rem;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--mars)}
.card.b .hint{color:var(--ice)}
.card[aria-expanded="true"] .hint{display:none}

/* poll */
.poll{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,3.5rem);align-items:center}
.qrbox{background:#fff;padding:14px;border-radius:22px;width:clamp(170px,22vw,260px);aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-items:center}
.qrbox img,.qrbox canvas{width:100%!important;height:auto!important}
.qrcap{margin:.9rem 0 0;font-weight:700;text-align:center}
.live{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.45rem;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.4rem}
.live i{width:.55rem;height:.55rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted)}
.live.on i{background:#2FD27A;box-shadow:0 0 10px #2FD27A}
.pq{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.8vw,2.1rem);line-height:1.15;margin:.3rem 0 1.4rem}
.qnum{color:var(--muted);margin:0;font-size:.95rem}
.road{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(5.5rem,auto) 1fr 3.4rem;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;margin:.7rem 0}
.road .lbl{font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem}
.track{position:relative;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.track::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;border-top:2px dashed var(--line)}
.fill{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,color-mix(in srgb,var(--mars) 35%,transparent));
  transition:width .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.car{position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;width:64px;transform:translate(0,-50%);transition:left .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);color:var(--mars)}
.road .cnt{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;text-align:right}
.road .plus{display:none}
body.editing .road .plus{display:inline-block}
.plus{border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:.1rem .45rem;margin-left:.3rem;font-size:.85rem}
.road.right .car{color:#2FD27A}
.road.right .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(47,210,122,.4))}
.road.right .lbl::after{content:" ✓";color:#2FD27A}
.road.dim{opacity:.4}
.pctl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem;margin-top:1.4rem}
.pbtn{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:.55rem 1.1rem;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem}
.pbtn.main{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
.pnote{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;margin:.8rem 0 0;max-width:46ch}

/* end */
.end h2{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,8rem);line-height:.9;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.end p{font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.5rem);margin:1.4rem 0 0;max-width:32ch}

.end{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;gap:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,3.5rem);align-items:center}
.end .who{color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.team{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);transform:rotate(1.5deg);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--glass),0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.team img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
@media (max-width:760px){.end{grid-template-columns:1fr}.team{order:-1;transform:none}}
/* ============ HUD ============ */
.hud{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:5;padding:.9rem clamp(1rem,4vw,3rem) calc(.9rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem}
.ticks{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;height:44px;position:relative;min-width:0}
.ticks::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:2px;background:var(--line)}
.tk{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:0;height:44px;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;display:grid;place-items:center}
.tk i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--muted);transition:all .3s}
.tk.past i{background:var(--muted)}
.tk.on i{width:16px;height:16px;background:var(--mars);border-color:var(--mars);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--mars)}
.tk span{position:absolute;bottom:-2px;font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
.tk:hover span,.tk.on span{opacity:1}
.nbtn{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.nbtn.next{background:var(--mars);border-color:var(--mars);color:#fff;width:56px;height:56px}
.nbtn svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.mini{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);border-radius:999px;padding:.5rem .9rem;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;flex:none}
.mini[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}

/* warp flash */
body.warping #odo{-webkit-text-stroke-color:var(--mars)}

/* ============ VOTER MODE ============ */
.voter{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;overflow-y:auto;padding:2rem 1.25rem 3rem}
.voter .in{max-width:520px;margin:0 auto}
.voter h1{font-family:"Unbounded",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:2.2rem;line-height:1;margin:0 0 .5rem}
.voter .sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 1.8rem}
.vq{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:1.2rem;margin-bottom:1rem;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.vq h2{font-size:1.1rem;margin:0 0 .9rem;line-height:1.3}
.vopts{display:grid;gap:.5rem}
.vopts button{text-align:left;padding:.9rem 1rem;border-radius:14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem}
.vopts button.sel{background:var(--mars);border-color:var(--mars);color:#fff}
.vstat{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin:.6rem 0 0;min-height:1.2em}

@media (max-width:760px){
  #stage{align-items:flex-start;overflow-y:auto;padding-top:1.5rem}
  .year{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .frame{aspect-ratio:16/10;order:-1}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .poll{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .qrbox{margin:0 auto}
  .tk span{display:none}
  .mini.hide-sm{display:none}
  .ticks{display:none}
  .hud{justify-content:space-between}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .scene,.car,.fill,.v{transition:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stars" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<div id="odo" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<main id="stage" aria-live="polite"></main>
<nav class="hud" id="hud" aria-label="Timeline">
  <button class="nbtn" id="prev" aria-label="Previous"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button>
  <div class="ticks" id="ticks"></div>
  <button class="mini" id="gBtn" aria-pressed="false">Grammar</button>
  <button class="mini hide-sm" id="eBtn" aria-pressed="false">Edit</button>
  <button class="nbtn next" id="next" aria-label="Next"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
</nav>
<input type="file" id="file" accept="image/*" hidden>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* ================================================================
   EDIT HERE: names, photos (URLs work once the site is on GitHub Pages)
   ================================================================ */
const SPEAKERS = { A: "Simon", B: "Valentina" };
const TEAM_PHOTO = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
const PHOTO_URLS = {
  // 1971: "https://...jpg",
};

/* ================= CONTENT ================= */
const ps = t => `<span class="v ps">${t}</span>`;
const pc = t => `<span class="v pc">${t}</span>`;
const pp = t => `<span class="v pp">${t}</span>`;

const SCENES = [
  { type:"title" },
  { type:"part", sp:"A", n:"Part one", title:"The Dreamer", text:"A curious kid who read everything and wanted to change the world." },
  { type:"year", sp:"A", y:1971, icon:"globe", title:"A boy in Pretoria",
    body:`Elon Musk ${ps("was born")} on June 28 in Pretoria, South Africa. As a child, he ${pc("was always reading")}, sometimes ten hours a day.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"A", y:1984, icon:"code", title:"His first sale",
    body:`At 12, he ${ps("sold")} a video game called <i>Blastar</i> for about $500. He ${pp("had taught")} himself to program from a book.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"A", y:1989, icon:"plane", title:"A new country",
    body:`At 17, he ${ps("moved")} to Canada alone. Later he ${ps("studied")} physics and economics in the United States.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"A", y:1995, icon:"pin", title:"Zip2",
    body:`He ${ps("left")} Stanford after just two days. With his brother Kimbal, he ${ps("started")} Zip2, an online city guide. They ${pc("were sleeping")} in the office to save money.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"A", y:1999, icon:"coin", title:"The first millions",
    body:`Compaq ${ps("bought")} Zip2 for about $307 million. Musk ${ps("used")} the money to start X.com, which later ${ps("became")} PayPal.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"A", y:2002, icon:"rocket", title:"Eyes on Mars",
    body:`eBay ${ps("bought")} PayPal for $1.5 billion. That same year, he ${ps("founded")} SpaceX because he ${pc("was dreaming")} of sending people to Mars.` },
  { type:"voice", sp:"A", cards:[
    { when:"2002, about SpaceX", direct:"“I think we have maybe a 10% chance of success.”",
      rep:`He said that he ${ps("thought")} they ${ps("had")} maybe a 10% chance of success.`, shift:"think → thought, have → had, we → they" },
    { when:"2013, at a conference", direct:"“I would like to die on Mars. Just not on impact.”",
      rep:`He joked that he ${ps("would like")} to die on Mars, just not on impact.`, shift:"would stays would, I → he" } ]},
  { type:"part", sp:"B", n:"Part two", title:"The Risk-Taker", text:"Everything he built was about to crash, or fly." },
  { type:"year", sp:"B", y:2004, icon:"car", title:"Tesla",
    body:`He ${ps("invested")} in a small electric car company called Tesla and ${ps("became")} its chairman.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"B", y:2008, icon:"orbit", title:"The hardest year",
    body:`Both companies ${pc("were running out")} of money. SpaceX’s rocket ${pp("had failed")} three times, but in September the fourth launch finally ${ps("reached")} orbit. In October, he ${ps("became")} Tesla’s CEO.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"B", y:2012, icon:"station", title:"Dragon",
    body:`SpaceX’s Dragon ${ps("became")} the first private spacecraft to visit the International Space Station.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"B", y:2015, icon:"landing", title:"The rocket came back",
    body:`A Falcon 9 rocket ${ps("landed")} back on Earth after a launch. Nobody ${pp("had done")} that with an orbital rocket before.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"B", y:2020, icon:"astro", title:"Astronauts on board",
    body:`SpaceX ${ps("carried")} NASA astronauts to the Space Station. While the world ${pc("was living")} through the pandemic, millions ${pc("were watching")} online.` },
  { type:"year", sp:"B", y:2022, icon:"chat", title:"Twitter becomes X",
    body:`He ${ps("bought")} Twitter for $44 billion. In 2023, he ${ps("changed")} its name to X.` },
  { type:"voice", sp:"B", cards:[
    { when:"2014, in a TV interview", direct:"“When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.”",
      rep:`He said that when something ${ps("was")} important enough, you ${ps("did")} it even if the odds ${ps("were")} not in your favor.`, shift:"is → was, do → did, are → were" },
    { when:"2008, what people said about him", direct:"“Electric cars will never be popular.”",
      rep:`Many experts said that electric cars ${ps("would")} never be popular. Tesla ${ps("proved")} them wrong.`, shift:"will → would" } ]},
  { type:"poll" },
  { type:"end" }
];

const POLL = [
  { q:"What did Musk say SpaceX’s chance of success was?", opts:["10%","50%","90%"], right:0 },
  { q:"How many launches had failed before the first success in 2008?", opts:["One","Three","Five"], right:1 },
  { q:"Would you go to Mars if you had the chance?", opts:["Yes!","No way","Only with Wi-Fi"] },
  { q:"Which company impressed you the most?", opts:["SpaceX","Tesla","PayPal","X"] }
];

/* ================= ICONS ================= */
const ICONS = {
  globe:`<circle cx="60" cy="60" r="40"/><ellipse cx="60" cy="60" rx="16" ry="40"/><path d="M20 60h80M26 40h68M26 80h68"/>`,
  code:`<rect x="16" y="24" width="88" height="60" rx="8"/><path d="M48 44l-12 10 12 10M72 44l12 10-12 10M64 40l-8 28M44 98h32M60 84v14"/>`,
  plane:`<path d="M14 66l92-34-26 64-18-22-24 14 6-24z"/><path d="M62 74l44-42"/>`,
  pin:`<path d="M60 104s-32-34-32-56a32 32 0 0164 0c0 22-32 56-32 56z"/><circle cx="60" cy="48" r="11"/>`,
  coin:`<circle cx="60" cy="60" r="40"/><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="30"/><path d="M70 47c-3-4-7-5-11-5-6 0-10 3-10 8 0 11 22 6 22 17 0 5-5 9-11 9-5 0-9-2-12-6M60 36v48"/>`,
  rocket:`<path d="M60 12c16 14 22 34 18 60H42c-4-26 2-46 18-60z"/><circle cx="60" cy="44" r="7"/><path d="M42 72l-12 16 14-2M78 72l12 16-14-2M52 86c0 10 8 20 8 20s8-10 8-20"/>`,
  car:`<path d="M12 74c0-8 6-12 14-13l14-13c4-4 9-6 15-6h16c6 0 11 2 15 6l12 13c8 1 10 5 10 13v6H12z"/><circle cx="34" cy="82" r="10"/><circle cx="86" cy="82" r="10"/><path d="M44 50l-6 11h48l-8-11"/>`,
  orbit:`<circle cx="60" cy="60" r="14"/><ellipse cx="60" cy="60" rx="48" ry="18" transform="rotate(-25 60 60)"/><path d="M98 34l6-4-2 7"/>`,
  station:`<rect x="48" y="50" width="24" height="20" rx="3"/><path d="M48 60H30M72 60h18"/><rect x="8" y="44" width="22" height="32"/><rect x="90" y="44" width="22" height="32"/><path d="M60 50V30M54 30h12l-6-12z"/>`,
  landing:`<path d="M60 16c10 9 13 22 11 40H49c-2-18 1-31 11-40z"/><path d="M49 56l-10 18M71 56l10 18M30 98h60M40 98l20-12 20 12"/><path d="M56 62v8M64 62v8" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>`,
  astro:`<circle cx="60" cy="50" r="28"/><rect x="42" y="40" width="36" height="20" rx="10"/><path d="M32 100c0-16 12-26 28-26s28 10 28 26"/>`,
  chat:`<path d="M20 30h80v48H52l-20 16V78H20z"/><path d="M38 48h44M38 62h28"/>`
};
const icon = k => `<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 120 120" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${ICONS[k]||ICONS.rocket}</svg>`;
const CAR = `<svg viewBox="0 0 64 28" fill="currentColor"><path d="M2 18c0-3 2-5 6-5.5l7-6C17 5 19.5 4 22.5 4h15c3 0 5.5 1 7.5 2.5l6 6c5 .5 9 2 11 4.5v5H2z"/><circle cx="15" cy="22" r="5" fill="var(--bg)" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="49" cy="22" r="5" fill="var(--bg)" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"/><path d="M21 8h8v5h-13z M33 8h7l5 5H33z" fill="var(--bg)" opacity=".6"/></svg>`;

/* ================= STORAGE HELPERS ================= */
const store = {
  get(k){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(k) }catch(e){ return null } },
  set(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k,v); return true }catch(e){ return false } },
  del(k){ try{ localStorage.removeItem(k) }catch(e){} }
};

/* ================= LIVE POLL (ntfy.sh, works on GitHub Pages) ================= */
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const VOTE_TOPIC = params.get("vote");
const NTFY = "https://ntfy.sh/";


/* ---------------- VOTER PAGE ---------------- */
function renderVoter(){
  document.getElementById("hud").remove();
  document.getElementById("odo").remove();
  const stage = document.getElementById("stage");
  stage.className = "voter"; stage.id = "voter";
  let me = store.get("voterId"); if(!me){ me = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10); store.set("voterId",me); }
  stage.innerHTML = `<div class="in"><h1>Elon Musk</h1><p class="sub">Tap your answers. The results appear on the big screen.</p>${
    POLL.map((p,qi)=>`<div class="vq" data-q="${qi}"><h2>${qi+1}. ${p.q}</h2><div class="vopts">${
      p.opts.map((o,oi)=>`<button data-o="${oi}">${o}</button>`).join("")}</div><p class="vstat"></p></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
  stage.querySelectorAll(".vq").forEach(box=>{
    const qi = +box.dataset.q, key = `voted:${VOTE_TOPIC}:${qi}`, stat = box.querySelector(".vstat");
    const mark = oi => box.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("sel", +b.dataset.o===oi));
    const prev = store.get(key); if(prev!==null){ mark(+prev); stat.textContent = "Sent. You can change your answer."; }
    box.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
      const oi = +b.dataset.o; mark(oi); stat.textContent = "Sending…";
      try{
        const r = await fetch(NTFY + encodeURIComponent(VOTE_TOPIC), { method:"POST", body:`v|${qi}|${oi}|${me}` });
        if(!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
        store.set(key, String(oi)); stat.textContent = "Sent. You can change your answer.";
      }catch(e){ stat.textContent = "Couldn’t send. Check your internet and tap again."; }
    }));
  });
  startStars();
}

/* ---------------- PRESENTER ---------------- */
let idx = 0, busy = false, editing = false;
let pollQ = 0, reveal = false, es = null, live = false;
let topic, pollStart;
const votes = POLL.map(()=>({}));        // votes[q][voterId] = option
const manual = POLL.map(p=>p.opts.map(()=>0));

function initPresenter(){
  topic = store.get("pollTopic"); pollStart = +store.get("pollStart") || 0;
  if(!topic){ newTopic(); }
  buildTicks();
  const h = location.hash.slice(1); const hi = SCENES.findIndex((s,i)=>sceneId(s,i)===h);
  idx = hi >= 0 ? hi : 0;
  show(idx, true);
  startStars();
  document.getElementById("prev").onclick = ()=>go(-1);
  document.getElementById("next").onclick = ()=>go(1);
  const g = document.getElementById("gBtn");
  g.onclick = ()=>{ const on = document.body.classList.toggle("grammar"); g.setAttribute("aria-pressed",on); };
  const e = document.getElementById("eBtn");
  e.onclick = ()=>{ editing = document.body.classList.toggle("editing"); e.setAttribute("aria-pressed",editing); };
  addEventListener("keydown", ev=>{
    if(ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest("input,textarea")) return;
    if(["ArrowRight","PageDown"," "].includes(ev.key)){ ev.preventDefault(); go(1); }
    else if(["ArrowLeft","PageUp"].includes(ev.key)){ ev.preventDefault(); go(-1); }
    else if(ev.key==="g"||ev.key==="G") g.click();
    else if(ev.key==="e"||ev.key==="E") e.click();
  });
  let tx=null, ty=null;
  addEventListener("touchstart", ev=>{ tx=ev.touches[0].clientX; ty=ev.touches[0].clientY; }, {passive:true});
  addEventListener("touchend", ev=>{
    if(tx===null) return; const dx = ev.changedTouches[0].clientX-tx, dy = ev.changedTouches[0].clientY-ty;
    if(Math.abs(dx)>60 && Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*1.5) go(dx<0?1:-1); tx=null;
  }, {passive:true});
}

function newTopic(){
  topic = "muskpoll-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,12);
  pollStart = Math.floor(Date.now()/1000) - 5;
  store.set("pollTopic", topic); store.set("pollStart", String(pollStart));
}

function sceneId(s,i){ return s.type==="year" ? "y"+s.y : s.type==="poll" ? "poll" : s.type==="end" ? "end" : s.type==="title" ? "start" : s.type+i; }

function buildTicks(){
  const t = document.getElementById("ticks");
  t.innerHTML = SCENES.map((s,i)=>{
    const label = s.type==="year" ? s.y : s.type==="title" ? "Start" : s.type==="part" ? s.title : s.type==="voice" ? "Voice" : s.type==="poll" ? "Your turn" : "End";
    return `<button class="tk" data-i="${i}" aria-label="${label}"><i></i><span>${label}</span></button>`;
  }).join("");
  t.querySelectorAll(".tk").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>jump(+b.dataset.i));
}
function updateTicks(){
  document.querySelectorAll(".tk").forEach((b,i)=>{ b.classList.toggle("on",i===idx); b.classList.toggle("past",i<idx); });
}

function go(d){ const n = idx+d; if(n<0||n>=SCENES.length) return; jump(n); }

function lastYearAt(i){ for(let k=i;k>=0;k--) if(SCENES[k].y) return SCENES[k].y; return null; }

function jump(n){
  if(busy || n===idx) return;
  busy = true;
  const from = lastYearAt(idx), to = lastYearAt(n);
  const cur = document.querySelector(".scene");
  if(cur) cur.classList.add("out");
  warp(n>idx?1:-1);
  if(to && from && to!==from) countYear(from,to); 
  setTimeout(()=>{ idx = n; show(n); busy=false; }, reduced ? 50 : 380);
}

function show(i, first){
  const s = SCENES[i];
  const stage = document.getElementById("stage");
  stage.innerHTML = `<div class="scene ${first?'':'in'}">${render(s)}</div>`;
  const sc = stage.firstElementChild;
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>sc.classList.remove("in")));
  const odo = document.getElementById("odo");
  const y = s.type==="year" ? s.y : null;
  if(y){ odo.classList.remove("hide"); if(first || !odo.textContent) odo.textContent = y; } else odo.classList.add("hide");
  updateTicks();
  try{ history.replaceState(null,"","#"+sceneId(s,i)); }catch(e){}
  wire(s);
  stage.scrollTop = 0;
}

const tagHtml = sp => `<div class="tag ${sp==='B'?'b':''}"><i></i>${SPEAKERS[sp]}</div>`;

function render(s){
  if(s.type==="title") return `<div class="title">
      <h1>Elon<span>Musk</span></h1>
      <p class="hook">In 2008, he almost lost everything. Ten years later, his rockets were landing by themselves. What happened?</p>
      <p class="who">Presented by <b>${SPEAKERS.A}</b> and <b>${SPEAKERS.B}</b></p>
      <button class="start" id="startBtn">Start the journey <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
    </div>`;
  if(s.type==="part") return `<div class="part ${s.sp==='B'?'b':'a'}"><p class="num">${s.n}</p><h2>${s.title}</h2><p>${s.text}</p><p class="speaker">${SPEAKERS[s.sp]}</p></div>`;
  if(s.type==="year"){
    const local = store.get("photo:"+s.y), url = PHOTO_URLS[s.y];
    const media = local ? `<img src="${local}" alt="">` : url ? `<img src="${url}" alt="">` : icon(s.icon);
    return `<div class="year">
      <div>${tagHtml(s.sp)}<p class="yr">${s.y}</p><h2>${s.title}</h2><p class="body">${s.body}</p>
        <div class="legend"><span class="ps">Past simple</span><span class="pc">Past continuous</span><span class="pp">Past perfect</span></div></div>
      <div class="frame">${media}
        <div class="ed"><button data-act="add">${local?'Change photo':'Add photo'}</button>${local?'<button data-act="rm">Remove</button>':''}</div>
      </div></div>`;
  }
  if(s.type==="voice") return `<div class="voice">${tagHtml(s.sp)}<h2>In their own words</h2><div class="cards">${
    s.cards.map(c=>`<button class="card ${s.sp==='B'?'b':''}" aria-expanded="false"><p class="when">${c.when}</p><p class="direct">${c.direct}</p><p class="rep">${c.rep}</p><p class="shift">${c.shift}</p><span class="hint">Tap to report it</span></button>`).join("")}</div>
    <div class="legend"><span class="ps">Past simple</span><span class="pc">Past continuous</span><span class="pp">Past perfect</span></div></div>`;
  if(s.type==="poll") return `<div class="poll">
      <div><div class="qrbox" id="qr"></div><p class="qrcap">Scan to vote</p><p class="live" id="live"><i></i><span>Connecting…</span></p></div>
      <div><p class="qnum" id="qnum"></p><h2 class="pq" id="pq"></h2><div id="roads"></div>
        <div class="pctl">
          <button class="pbtn" id="qPrev">Previous question</button>
          <button class="pbtn main" id="qReveal">Show answer</button>
          <button class="pbtn" id="qNext">Next question</button>
        </div>
        <p class="pnote" id="pnote"></p></div></div>`;
  if(s.type==="end") return `<div class="end"><div><h2>Thank you</h2><p>Any questions about our timeline?</p><p class="who">${SPEAKERS.A} and ${SPEAKERS.B}</p></div><div class="team"><img src="${TEAM_PHOTO}" alt="${SPEAKERS.A} and ${SPEAKERS.B} with Elon Musk"></div></div>`;
  return "";
}

function wire(s){
  if(s.type==="title"){ const b=document.getElementById("startBtn"); if(b) b.onclick=()=>go(1); }
  if(s.type==="voice") document.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>c.setAttribute("aria-expanded", c.getAttribute("aria-expanded")!=="true"));
  if(s.type==="year"){
    document.querySelectorAll(".ed button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
      if(b.dataset.act==="rm"){ store.del("photo:"+s.y); show(idx); return; }
      const f = document.getElementById("file"); f.value=""; f.onchange=()=>loadPhoto(f.files[0], s.y); f.click();
    });
  }
  if(s.type==="poll") setupPoll();
}

function loadPhoto(file, y){
  if(!file) return;
  const img = new Image(), fr = new FileReader();
  fr.onload = ()=>{ img.onload = ()=>{
      const max = 1000, k = Math.min(1, max/Math.max(img.width,img.height));
      const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = img.width*k; c.height = img.height*k;
      c.getContext("2d").drawImage(img,0,0,c.width,c.height);
      const ok = store.set("photo:"+y, c.toDataURL("image/jpeg",.82));
      if(!ok) alert("This browser couldn’t save the photo. Try a smaller image.");
      show(idx);
    }; img.src = fr.result; };
  fr.readAsDataURL(file);
}

/* ---------------- POLL (presenter side) ---------------- */
function voteUrl(){ return location.origin + location.pathname + "?vote=" + encodeURIComponent(topic); }

function setupPoll(){
  const qr = document.getElementById("qr");
  if(window.QRCode){ try{ new QRCode(qr,{ text:voteUrl(), width:512, height:512, colorDark:"#1B1530", colorLight:"#ffffff", correctLevel:QRCode.CorrectLevel.M }); }catch(e){ qr.textContent="QR unavailable"; } }
  else qr.textContent = "QR unavailable";
  document.getElementById("qPrev").onclick = ()=>{ if(pollQ>0){ pollQ--; reveal=false; drawPoll(); } };
  document.getElementById("qNext").onclick = ()=>{ if(pollQ<POLL.length-1){ pollQ++; reveal=false; drawPoll(); } };
  document.getElementById("qReveal").onclick = ()=>{ reveal=!reveal; drawPoll(); };
  connect(); drawPoll(); setLive(live);
}

function connect(){
  if(es) return;
  try{
    es = new EventSource(`${NTFY}${encodeURIComponent(topic)}/sse?since=${pollStart}`);
    es.onopen = ()=>setLive(true);
    es.onerror = ()=>setLive(false);
    es.onmessage = ev=>{
      try{
        const d = JSON.parse(ev.data); if(d.event && d.event!=="message") return;
        const [k,q,o,id] = String(d.message||"").split("|");
        if(k!=="v") return; const qi=+q, oi=+o;
        if(!POLL[qi] || !(oi>=0 && oi<POLL[qi].opts.length) || !id) return;
        votes[qi][id.slice(0,20)] = oi; drawPoll();
      }catch(e){}
    };
  }catch(e){ setLive(false); }
}

function setLive(on){
  live = on;
  const el = document.getElementById("live"); if(!el) return;
  el.classList.toggle("on", on);
  el.querySelector("span").textContent = on ? "Live" : "Offline";
  const n = document.getElementById("pnote");
  if(n) n.textContent = on ? "" : "Live voting works when the site is published on GitHub Pages. Press E to count votes by hand.";
}

function tally(qi){
  const c = POLL[qi].opts.map((_,i)=>manual[qi][i]);
  Object.values(votes[qi]).forEach(o=>c[o]++); return c;
}

function drawPoll(){
  const p = POLL[pollQ], c = tally(pollQ), total = c.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  const qn = document.getElementById("qnum"); if(!qn) return;
  qn.textContent = `Question ${pollQ+1} of ${POLL.length}, ${total} vote${total===1?'':'s'}`;
  document.getElementById("pq").textContent = p.q;
  const hasRight = typeof p.right==="number";
  const rb = document.getElementById("qReveal");
  rb.style.display = hasRight ? "" : "none"; rb.textContent = reveal ? "Hide answer" : "Show answer";
  const roads = document.getElementById("roads");
  if(roads.dataset.q !== String(pollQ)){
    roads.dataset.q = pollQ;
    roads.innerHTML = p.opts.map((o,i)=>`<div class="road" data-i="${i}"><div class="lbl">${o}</div>
      <div class="track"><div class="fill"></div><div class="car">${CAR}</div></div>
      <div class="cnt"><span>0</span><button class="plus" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Add a vote for ${o}">+1</button></div></div>`).join("");
    roads.querySelectorAll(".plus").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{ manual[pollQ][+b.dataset.i]++; drawPoll(); });
  }
  roads.querySelectorAll(".road").forEach((r,i)=>{
    const pct = total ? c[i]/total : 0;
    r.querySelector(".fill").style.width = (pct*100)+"%";
    r.querySelector(".car").style.left = `calc(${pct*100}% - ${pct*64}px)`;
    r.querySelector(".cnt span").textContent = total ? Math.round(pct*100)+"%" : "0";
    r.classList.toggle("right", reveal && hasRight && i===p.right);
    r.classList.toggle("dim", reveal && hasRight && i!==p.right);
  });
}

/* ================= STARFIELD + WARP ================= */
const reduced = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
let speed = 0.6, target = 0.6, dir = 1;
function warp(d){ if(reduced) return; dir = d; target = 28; document.body.classList.add("warping");
  setTimeout(()=>{ target = 0.6; document.body.classList.remove("warping"); }, 520); }

function countYear(a,b){
  const odo = document.getElementById("odo"); if(reduced){ odo.textContent=b; return; }
  const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 700;
  (function step(t){ const k = Math.min(1,(t-t0)/dur), e = 1-Math.pow(1-k,3);
    odo.textContent = Math.round(a+(b-a)*e); if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); })(t0);
}

function startStars(){
  const cv = document.getElementById("stars"), ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  let W,H,DPR; const N = 260, stars=[];
  function size(){ DPR=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1); W=cv.width=innerWidth*DPR; H=cv.height=innerHeight*DPR; }
  size(); addEventListener("resize", size);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++) stars.push({x:(Math.random()-.5)*2,y:(Math.random()-.5)*2,z:Math.random()});
  let rgb = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--star").trim() || "242,238,247";
  matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener?.("change",()=>{ rgb = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--star").trim(); });
  function frame(){
    speed += (target-speed)*0.12;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    const cx=W/2, cy=H/2, f=Math.max(W,H)*.6;
    for(const s of stars){
      const pz = s.z;
      s.z -= 0.0009*speed*dir;
      if(s.z<=0.02){ s.z=1; s.x=(Math.random()-.5)*2; s.y=(Math.random()-.5)*2; }
      if(s.z>1){ s.z=0.03; s.x=(Math.random()-.5)*2; s.y=(Math.random()-.5)*2; }
      const x=cx+s.x/s.z*f*.5, y=cy+s.y/s.z*f*.5;
      const px=cx+s.x/pz*f*.5, py=cy+s.y/pz*f*.5;
      const a = Math.min(1,(1-s.z)*1.2);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${rgb},${a})`; ctx.lineWidth=(1-s.z)*2.2*DPR;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px,py); ctx.lineTo(x+.1,y+.1); ctx.stroke();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if(reduced){ speed=target=0; }
  frame();
}

if (VOTE_TOPIC) { renderVoter(); } else { initPresenter(); }
</script>
</body>
</html>
